Select approved drugs with HIV infection indication. Join drug_indication on mesh_heading or efo_term matching HIV infection. Join molecule_dictionary for drug identifiers and names. Join compound_structures for canonical SMILES as an INNER JOIN. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
